sentence: This project studies how the field of statistics is changing and where it may head, including its ties to deep learning and data science.
This project continues a program that trains cybersecurity professionals and researchers for government service.
This project develops theory and algorithms for making decisions under uncertainty.
This project builds and tests teaching methods that help engineers protect manufacturing plants and power systems from cyberattacks that use artificial intelligence.
This project tries to find out why the great star coral survives stress, by studying its six genetically distinct lineages.
This project studies how to teach artificial intelligence concepts in rural elementary classrooms and how teachers can help.
This project searches for a nuclear decay that would show whether neutrinos are the same as their anti-particles.
This project studies which genes shape skin pigmentation and how they changed during human evolution.
This project collects network measurements to understand how well research and engineering networks hold up against failures and attacks.
This project builds a device that uses plasma and a filter to remove soot from the exhaust of large diesel engines.
This project develops a chip packaging material made with hexagonal boron nitride nanosheets to conduct heat better.
This project creates a computational method that keeps manufactured parts performing well despite cyberphysical attacks that alter digital representations.
This project tests whether single crystal turbine blades can be made from additively manufactured nickel alloys by directional recrystallization.
This project develops an X-ray scanner upgrade that uses artificial intelligence to tell dangerous items from ordinary ones in security screening.
This project develops fast methods for comparing probability distributions of data, using a technique called stochastic localization.
This project builds a computational model of each prostate cancer patient that forecasts radiation dose and helps choose the drug dosage.
This project builds quantum computing hardware whose qubits flag when and where errors occur, so the errors are easier to correct.
